plan.notes: Term-by-term sample plan transcribed verbatim from the official Augustana University 2022-2023 Undergraduate General Catalog, Biology Major page (degree BA per augie.edu: 'Earn a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in biology degree at Augustana University'). The 2022-2023 catalog is the most recent catalog year whose sample plan is published inline in HTML; the current (2026-2027) catalog links its sample plan as a Google Sheet, which is not retrievable via text-fetch tools (direct fetches return HTTP 400 from docs.google.com). 'Core, Major, Minor or Elective Course (3-4)' and 'Elective course at the 300-level (3-4)' slots seeded at base 3 cr as choice:true. BIOL 490 (0 cr) is a required course, seeded with required_zero:true. CHEM 117 and PHYS 201/202 appear in the sample plan (pre-professional preparation / strongly recommended per catalog) but are not in the major's required or required-supportive lists (supportive = one of CHEM 116/120, one of CHEM 145/201, one math course); they are categorized as major with this note. The required math course (MATH 150/151/280 or ECON 270/PSYC 270 or BIOL 370) and BIOL 491 (Biology Seminar II, 1 cr) are not explicitly placed in the plan; filler slots absorb them. Year 3 Interim is empty in the catalog's plan (no courses listed) and is transcribed as an empty semester. Catalog states 124 total credits are needed for degree completion.
